response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive experience in software development, leadership, and open-source contributions, aligning well with the Tech Lead role. His background includes managing interdisciplinary teams, designing scalable systems, and mentoring developers. However, his German proficiency is only at a basic level, which may impact client interactions, and his recent leadership experience is limited to staff engineering rather than executive-level oversight.
strengths: Strong technical leadership with experience in multiple programming languages and architectures
Proven track record in open-source projects and community engagement
Diverse industry experience across IT consulting, embedded systems, and AI infrastructure
concerns: Limited German proficiency (basic level) despite job requiring C1
Recent leadership experience is at staff engineer level, not executive/Head of Development
No explicit mention of UML expertise or requirements management experience
